page.layout: One page: a dark red leather book cover, with a gold-tooled oval emblem (a serpent on a shield within a wreath, under a crown) at the centre. Gold rules frame the board. A faint "Google" digitiser mark sits at the lower right corner. No printed text.
page.notes: Front board of a bound volume, not a printed page. The gold oval emblem shows a serpent (staff of Aesculapius-type device) on a shield within a laurel wreath and crown; it carries no legible words. The "Google" watermark at the lower right is the digitiser's mark and is left out.
